name: create_view
title: Create View
description: Creates a ViewProvider over a sub-range of the currently selected data source. Views are read-only (ViewProvider::isWritable() returns false by design), so this is the safe way for an agent to inspect a region without ever mutating the source. The view is added to the provider list and becomes selectable via select_data_source. [M] mutates the provider list. If 'name' is empty, the view is named '<base> View' (matching the GUI behavior).

address.description: Start address of the view (relative to the base provider)

size.description: Size of the view in bytes

name.description: Optional display name for the view (shown in select_data_source results)

handle.description: Handle of the newly created view

base_handle.description: Handle of the source provider the view is over
